Fields.Name: Menu Resource Type
Fields.Description: Menu resource used to display this tutorial.

Fields.Name: Menu Resource ID
Fields.Description: ID of the image (or movie, depending on the menu resource type) shown by this tutorial.

Fields.Name: Open SE ID
Fields.Description: SE to play when the tutorial opens

Fields.Name: Close SE ID
Fields.Description: SE to play when the tutorial closes

Fields.Name: Repeat Type
Fields.Description: Determines whether or not the tutorial can replay

Fields.Name: Multi-Response
Fields.Description: If ON, several key guide responses can be shown at the same time.

Fields.Name: Display Event Flag
Fields.Description: Event flag ID for display permission. Will not be displayed until the specified event flag is set (0: Always allowed)

Fields.Name: Tutorial Act Judge ID [1]
Fields.Description: TutorialActJudgeParam row that checks the input for line 1 of the key guide.

Fields.Name: Tutorial Act Judge ID [2]
Fields.Description: TutorialActJudgeParam row that checks the input for line 2 of the key guide.

Fields.Name: Tutorial Act Judge ID [3]
Fields.Description: TutorialActJudgeParam row that checks the input for line 3 of the key guide.

Fields.Name: Tutorial Act Judge ID [4]
Fields.Description: TutorialActJudgeParam row that checks the input for line 4 of the key guide.
